ja285:1.1: Dariyā sattavassāni tiṃsamattā vasāmase, ‘hañchema maṇino ābhaṃ' iti no mantitaṃ ahu.
ja285:2.1: Yāva yāva nighaṃsāma bhiyyo vodāyate maṇi, brāhmaṇaṃ tv-eva pucchāma: ‘kiṃ kiccaṃ idha maññasīti'.
ja285:3.1: Ayaṃ maṇī veḷuriyo akāco vimalo subho, nāssa sakkā siriṃ hantuṃ, apakkamatha sūkarā ti.
